title: Figures 26-27: IPG Photonics single-mode fiber laser modules and 50 kW multimode HPFL
description: Figure 26, "Single Mode Fiber Laser Modules," combines photos of compact laser modules (open chassis with fiber coils and a sealed unit) with specs including POUT up to 1,100 W, wavelength 1070 nm and weight ~12 kg. Figure 27, "Multimode HPFLs," shows a photo of a large multi-cabinet 50kW multimode fiber laser installation beside a bullet list of specs (DC EOE ~33%, weight ~2,500 kg, delivered August 2008). Images are credited to IPG Photonics and illustrate portable industrial high-power fiber lasers.
